name: Broad jump with stick landing
why: Landing well protects the knees on every dive and jump; a short forward jump teaches you to soak up force and hold still.

setup.space: About 2 m of clear floor in the jump direction.
setup.surface_note: A wooden floor, carpet over a firm floor, a thick mat or grass. Never on concrete or tiles laid on concrete.
setup.parent: Stand side-on near the landing spot.

steps: Stand behind a line, feet hip width.
Swing your arms back and bend into a quarter squat.
Swing the arms forward and jump forward a comfortable distance, not your longest.
Land on both feet with bent knees and hold still for two seconds.
Walk back to the line and reset before the next jump.

mistakes.mistake: Jumping as far as you can
mistakes.fix: Use about half effort; the landing is the skill.
Bend knees and hips as you land, like sitting back.
Shorten the jump until you can freeze for two seconds.

parent_check: Freezes for two seconds on landing
Knees bend and stay over the toes
stop_if: Pain in the knee, below the kneecap, heel or ankle
Chest pain, dizziness, feeling faint, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Landing on straight knees, or the knees cave in (end the set)

easier.variant: Snap down: rise onto the toes, drop into the landing shape and freeze, with no jump.
easier.use_when: The landing cannot be frozen for two seconds.

harder.variant: A slightly longer jump, still freezing for two seconds.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean in two sessions in a row, and the owner approves the change.
